title: A documented recovery guarantee was never wired: workflow runs wrote no recovery checkpoints
summary: docs/restart-recovery.md states that P0.1 writes a local recovery checkpoint whenever it saves a workflow run. recovery.checkpoint_workflow_record implemented it (2026-09-21, ce8a7323) but no caller ever existed, so staged workflows never wrote recovery checkpoints. orchestrate simplify flagged the function as unused; tracing it showed a missing integration, not dead code. Now called on run start and every save, with a git-backed regression test.
